name: Datadog JUnitXML Upload
description: Upload JUnitXML reports files to Datadog Test Optimization

api_key.description: Datadog API key to use to upload the junit files.

site.description: The Datadog site to upload the files to.

auto-discovery.description: Do a recursive search and automatic junit files discovery in the folders provided in `files` input (current folder if omitted).

ignored-paths.description: A comma-separated list of paths that are ignored when junit files auto-discovery is done. Glob patterns are supported

concurrency.description: Controls the maximum number of concurrent file uploads.

node-version.description: The node version used to install datadog-ci

tags.description: Datadog tags to associate with the uploaded test results.

service.description: Service name to use with the uploaded test results.

env.description: Datadog env to use for the tests.

logs.description: Set to "true" to enable forwarding content from XML reports as logs.

datadog-ci-version.description: The version of the @datadog/datadog-ci package to use. It defaults to the latest release (`latest`).

extra-args.description: Extra args to be passed to the datadog-ci cli.
